Question B-001-023-007.

Why the correct answer is right: Public consultation may not be required when the system is excluded by either the municipal process or CPC-2-0-03. The OR relationship means either source of exclusion can be enough in the stated situation.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "The system is excluded by the provisions of Client Procedures Circular CPC-2-0-03": This names only one possible exclusion source and omits the municipal-process alternative.
- sourceIndex 2: "The system is excluded by the municipal process": This names only the municipal exclusion path and omits the CPC-2-0-03 alternative.
- sourceIndex 3: "The system is excluded by the municipal process AND the provisions of Client Procedures Circular CPC-2-0-03": Requiring both exclusions is too strict; either exclusion source can be enough.
